title: Workflows End to End: Typed Ports, Real Schema Flow, Config on Node
description: Master program absorbing "Configured Node Apps" (.cursor/plans/configured_node_apps_30251998.plan.md) and "Workflows use pack/dsl" (ticket 26/07/30/WORKFLOWS-USE-PACK-DSL-DOCUMENTS-AND-PROTOCOL-OP-COMMANDS). Makes workflows the real integration layer: one canonical MediaPortSpec port model populated by all ~52 apps, one kernel Workflow document (node absorbs app-instance), per-node Config artifact for UI state, typed edge negotiation replacing string-equality checks, a live scheduler + headless SpaceRunner executing real data flow (flagship: block3d's object-kind catalog -> puzzle3d kit input). Full plan at /Users/ueli/.claude/plans/workflows-are-still-adhoc-zany-pearl.md. Executed wave by wave (0-6) via parallel sub-agents, file-disjoint packages per wave.
summary:
Wave fan-out: converted puzzle2d (✏️s/🔌️plugin/🧩️puzzle/🎛️app/◻2d/) from the old stringly-typed DocumentApp (handle_action + ambient RefCell<Puzzle2dPlayRuntime>/ViewState) to the pure DocumentApp trait shape, mirroring puzzle3d's already-converted template exactly.

Config recipe: `Puzzle2dPlayRuntime` (made `pub`) doubles as `Puzzle2dConfig` via `pub type Puzzle2dConfig = Puzzle2dPlayRuntime;` — a type alias, not a new type. Added 3 B1 fields the old host-pushed `ViewState` used to carry: `active_utility_by_window_id: BTreeMap<String,String>`, `locale: String`, `terminology: String`. Added `impl store::DocumentDsl/DocumentPack/ConfigRecord`, `impl protocol::OperationDiff<Puzzle2dPlayRuntime>`, and `Puzzle2dConfigOperation::Snapshot{config}` with `Operation`/`OpBinary`/`OpText` impls — all byte-for-byte mirroring `puzzle_3d_ui::Puzzle3dRuntime`/`Puzzle3dConfigOperation`. Added the `dsl` (semio-framework-os-kernel-dsl) crate dependency puzzle2d's ui Cargo.toml was missing (needed for `dsl::to_dsl_value`/`from_dsl_value` in the pack impl).

Command recipe: `Puzzle2dCommand` generated via a `puzzle2d_command_variants!` macro (same shape as puzzle3d's), 41 variants — one per registered `.operation`/`.view_action`/`.action_with` action id in `create_puzzle2d_app`, plus the framework-injected `setActiveUtility` and two NEW commands `setLocale`/`setTerminology` (added because ViewState no longer carries locale/terminology — mirrors puzzle3d's identical addition). `handle()` is a thin adapter calling the preserved pre-B1 business logic (renamed `handle_action_impl`), which now reads a passed `&Puzzle2dConfig` snapshot instead of `self.runtime.borrow()` and returns `Emit<Operation, ConfigOperation>` (document + config operations) instead of a bare `ActionEmit`. The one substantive logic change: `SET_ACTIVE_UTILITY_ACTION_ID`'s arm used to rely on the host having already applied the new utility to ViewState and did a bare early-return; it now itself writes `args.get("utilityId")` into `active_utility_by_window_id` and falls through to the common exit so the change becomes a real, undoable-via-config-store `Puzzle2dConfigOperation::Snapshot`.

Port recipe: `io()` declares `kit:in` (In, Kit×Type, kind_id "kit.catalog", Many) and `design:out` (Out, TwoD×Design, kind_id "2d.puzzle" — reused from the already-declared `ArtifactKindSpec`, Many). `import_media` always returns `Err(MediaError::NotImplemented)` — puzzle2d's own node/handle "kind catalogs" (weights keyed by this app's own node/handle kind vocabulary) are structurally unrelated to `kit.catalog`'s block3d object/vortex-kind vocabulary, so there is no honest normalization to write, documented with a docstring.

Multi-window: puzzle2d did NOT need puzzle3d's self-maintained `window_ids`/`load_window`/`save_window` workaround. Puzzle2dPlayRuntime carries no field that differs per window instance (unlike puzzle3d's per-window `window_options`), and puzzle2d has three DISTINCT pane kinds (not several instances of one kind), so `window_instance_ids(pane)` now just returns `vec![pane.to_string()]` unconditionally — a self-registered instance registry would only ever produce byte-identical duplicate entries.

Root-cause fix (pre-existing, unrelated to the trait conversion but blocking `cargo check --all-targets` on the engine crate): 3 tests in `⚙️engine/…/📦️lib.rs` referenced a nonexistent `super::board_icon_codec` module with a 1-arg call; fixed to the real `crate::canvas::icon_codec::board_resolve_icon_kind(text, puzzle_themed_icon_lookup)` (2-arg) path.

Verification: `cargo check --all-targets` across all 6 crates (engine/op/dsl/pack/protocol/ui) is 0 errors, only pre-existing unrelated warnings (identical baseline to puzzle3d's own warnings, e.g. the same `ViewState`-unused-outside-tests pattern). `cargo test --lib --no-fail-fast`: 150 tests total, 147 passed, 3 failed — all 3 failures are in the ENGINE crate's pre-existing BoardHost/icon-asset business logic, newly exposed (not newly broken) now that the crate compiles: `force_graph_tests::board_icon_codec_resolves_catalog_key_via_themed_lookup` (missing `capsule_J.svg` icon asset — only a `.3dm` CAD file exists in the metabolism icon directory), `host_tests::puzzle2d_default_manifest_satisfies_board_host_validation` (manifest declares a handle-kind color as the literal CSS var string `var(--muted-foreground)`, which BoardHost's color parser rejects), `host_tests::board_host_fill_base_core_rectangular_excludes_cylindric_tambour` (fill-placement algorithm expects 1 placement, gets 0). None touch Config/Command/DocumentApp/render — all three are pre-existing BoardHost/asset-pipeline/manifest-data bugs orthogonal to this ticket, left unfixed per the ticket's own scope guidance (same allowance puzzle3d's B1 wave used for its 9 known pre-existing framework-gap failures). `semio-s-app-puzzle-2d-ui` itself: 28/28 tests pass. op/dsl/pack/protocol: all pass (1/1/2/1 tests).

Saved full verbatim `cargo check`/`cargo test` output to this ticket folder: puzzle2d-cargo-check.txt, puzzle2d-cargo-test.txt.
